title: Casa Ardesia

coverImage.alt: House with a sweeping single-pitch zinc roof

summary: A new slate-and-zinc house with a sweeping single-pitch roof, clerestory windows and a net-zero energy design.
description:
Casa Ardesia takes its name from the dark slate that clads its entrance wall. A single zinc roof rises from the hillside towards the valley, with a ribbon of clerestory windows bringing light deep into the plan.

The main level holds an open living, dining and kitchen space; three bedrooms are arranged on two half-levels following the slope.

With rooftop solar, battery storage and a ground-source heat pump, the house is designed to produce as much energy as it uses over a year.

images.alt: House with a sweeping single-pitch zinc roof
Dark slate facade with a large window
Roofline with a clerestory window strip

title: Villa Seren

coverImage.alt: Courtyard pool between pale stone walls with climbing plants

summary: A single-storey courtyard villa among the vineyards, with deep stone loggias, a walled garden and a long reflecting pool.
description:
Villa Seren is a low, single-storey house wrapped around a walled courtyard, built in local stone with deep loggias that keep the rooms cool through the summer. Every bedroom opens directly onto the courtyard garden and its long reflecting pool.

The living wing has a stone fireplace, a library corner and a kitchen with a separate pantry; the bedroom wing holds four suites, each with its own bathroom.

Available furnished for lets of six months or more. Utilities and garden maintenance can be included by arrangement.

images.alt: Courtyard pool between pale stone walls with climbing plants
Reading corner with a leather lounge chair and an upright piano
Bathroom with a stone basin and dark tiled wall
Cypress-lined hills around the estate at dusk

title: Torre Alta Penthouse

coverImage.alt: Residential tower with continuous glass balconies

summary: The fourteenth-floor penthouse of Torre Alta, with a sea-facing terrace, a palm-shaded lounge and 24-hour concierge.
description:
Torre Alta is the tallest building in the new Porto Nuovo marina district, and its penthouse occupies the whole of the fourteenth floor. Every room faces the sea through floor-to-ceiling glazing.

The terrace is laid out for outdoor dining and lounging, with planters of palms and a glass balustrade. Residents share a lounge, gym and a 24-hour concierge desk.

Available furnished or unfurnished, minimum six-month lease.

images.alt: Residential tower with continuous glass balconies
Residents' lounge opening to a palm-shaded terrace
Terrace table and chairs facing a turquoise sea

title: Villa Aurelia

coverImage.alt: Infinity pool edge and stepped terrace overlooking wooded hills

summary: A new cliff-top villa of stacked travertine volumes, cantilevered terraces and a 22-metre infinity pool facing the western sea.
description:
Villa Aurelia sits on the last rise of the Punta Sera headland, arranged as two long travertine volumes that slide past each other to frame the horizon. The lower level opens entirely to the pool terrace through floor-to-ceiling sliding glass; the upper level holds four bedroom suites behind a screen of oak louvres that filter the afternoon light.

The principal suite occupies the cantilevered western end, with a private terrace that reaches out over the garden. A 22-metre infinity pool runs the length of the lower terrace, edged in honed limestone and planted with olive trees and cypress.

Completed in 2024 with geothermal heating, solar glazing and a home automation system, the house is ready to move into.

images.alt: Infinity pool edge and stepped terrace overlooking wooded hills
Pool terrace with a view across the open sea
Bedroom suite lined in warm oak with a full-height curtained window
Open-plan living and dining space with tall windows

title: Harbour Loft

coverImage.alt: Loft space with tall steel-framed windows

summary: A one-bedroom loft in a former boatyard, with steel-framed windows, a mezzanine study and the harbour on the doorstep.
description:
Harbour Loft occupies part of a former boatyard workshop in the Darsena, converted in 2016. Tall steel-framed windows light a single open living space; a steel stair leads to a mezzanine study above the kitchen.

The bedroom is tucked behind sliding doors at the rear, beside a shower room with a walk-in shower.

Offered unfurnished on a minimum 12-month lease.

images.alt: Loft space with tall steel-framed windows
Open living and dining area with exposed ducts
Steel staircase rising to a mezzanine

title: Casa Lume

coverImage.alt: Contemporary house with a fully glazed gable and timber cladding

summary: A two-storey contemporary family house of white render and dark timber, with a glazed gable living room and a garden pool.
description:
Casa Lume is built around a double-height living room whose glazed gable looks out over the Belvedere gardens towards the bay. The ground floor flows from a family kitchen with a long island into the dining room and onto a covered terrace beside the pool.

Upstairs, four bedrooms share a timber-lined gallery; the principal bedroom has a dressing room, a walk-in shower and a balcony facing the morning sun.

The house was completed in 2023 to a high energy standard, with heat-pump heating, underfloor cooling and photovoltaic panels on the roof.

images.alt: Contemporary house with a fully glazed gable and timber cladding
Bright family kitchen with an island and pendant lights
Calm bedroom with sheer curtains and soft daylight
Outdoor dining table on a planted terrace

title: The Cedar House
summary: A cedar-clad family house in the pine woods behind the beach, offered furnished with a planted patio and outdoor lounge.
description:
The Cedar House sits in a quiet lane of the Pineta, the pine wood that backs Riva Celeste's beach. Cedar boards and deep balconies give the upper floor a light, layered facade.

Inside, a sunny living room with a botanical wall opens onto a patio with an outdoor lounge and fire table. Three bedrooms are upstairs, each with a bathroom.

Available furnished from next month on a 12-month lease.

images.alt: Cedar-clad house with timber balconies
Living room with a botanical wallpaper wall
Patio lounge with an outdoor sofa and planting

title: Salt House Penthouse

coverImage.alt: Whitewashed terrace stepping down towards the sea

summary: The top floor of a converted salt warehouse on the old harbour, with a whitewashed wraparound terrace and views across the bay.
description:
The Salt House was the harbour's storage warehouse for two centuries before its conversion into eight apartments in 2021. The penthouse takes the whole top floor, with exposed roof trusses over a long living and dining room.

A whitewashed terrace wraps around three sides of the apartment, planted with lemon trees in terracotta pots and wide enough for outdoor dining for ten. All three bedrooms have their own bathrooms.

A private lift arrives directly in the apartment, and a secure parking space is included.

images.alt: Whitewashed terrace stepping down towards the sea
Long living room with sofas and steel-framed windows
Bedroom with walnut wardrobes and a bedside lamp
Lemon tree in a terracotta pot on the terrace wall above the bay

title: Le Onde, 7A

coverImage.alt: Curving white ribbon balconies on an apartment building

summary: A seventh-floor apartment in Le Onde, the wave-balconied building in central Marevento, with a long south-facing balcony.
description:
Le Onde is recognisable from the seafront by its ribbon balconies, which curve in and out along each floor. Apartment 7A has one of the longest, running past the living room and both bedrooms.

The open kitchen and living space is finished in pale oak, and the bathroom has a walk-in shower. The building has a concierge, bike store and underground parking.

Available unfurnished on a 12-month lease.

images.alt: Curving white ribbon balconies on an apartment building
Dining corner with a round table on a parquet floor
Stone watchtower above the sea near the town

title: Residenza Celeste, 4B

coverImage.alt: Glass-fronted apartment building with deep balconies

summary: A fourth-floor seafront apartment in a recent glass-and-stone building, with a deep balcony and herringbone oak floors.
description:
Apartment 4B faces the promenade from the fourth floor of Residenza Celeste, a 2022 building with shared gardens and a residents' pool. The living room runs the full width of the apartment and opens onto a deep balcony.

The kitchen is separate but connected by a wide opening, and both bedrooms have en-suite bathrooms. Floors throughout are herringbone oak.

A cellar store and an underground parking space are included in the price.

images.alt: Glass-fronted apartment building with deep balconies
Living room with herringbone floor and a blue sofa

title: Villa Campanile

coverImage.alt: Stucco villa with arched loggias and a lit pool at night

summary: A large stucco and terracotta villa with arched loggias, a lit pool terrace and six bedrooms for long family stays.
description:
Villa Campanile is a generous family villa in the classic coastal style: rendered walls, terracotta roofs and arched loggias around a large pool terrace that comes alive in the evening.

The house sleeps twelve across six bedrooms, with a separate staff flat above the garage. Gardens include a lemon orchard, a pizza oven and a bocce court.

Available for lets of three months or more, furnished, with weekly cleaning included.

images.alt: Stucco villa with arched loggias and a lit pool at night
Hillside village above the sea in late sun

title: Villa Marea

coverImage.alt: White modern villa with glass balconies and palm trees

summary: A three-level white villa above the Scogliera rocks, with glass balconies on every floor and a landscaped pool garden.
description:
Villa Marea steps down the Scogliera slope over three levels, each with a glass-fronted balcony facing the sea. The entrance level holds the living room, dining room and kitchen; the garden level opens onto a lawn and a pool lined with sun loungers.

Five bedrooms are split between the top floor and the garden level, which also has a gym and a self-contained guest suite.

The beach at Cala Marevento is a seven-minute walk down a private path.

images.alt: White modern villa with glass balconies and palm trees
Pool garden with sun loungers and parasols
Lounge with an ivory sofa and a chandelier

title: Casa Ulivo

coverImage.alt: House with stone lower walls and timber-clad upper floor

summary: A stone-and-timber house set in an old olive grove, with a covered veranda that runs the full length of the garden front.
description:
Casa Ulivo was built in 2020 on the footprint of a ruined olive mill, reusing its stone for the lower walls. Above, the upper floor is clad in larch and set back behind a long covered veranda.

The ground floor holds an open kitchen and dining room, a sitting room with a wood stove and a guest bedroom; three further bedrooms are upstairs.

The grove of around 90 olive trees is still harvested each autumn by a local cooperative.

images.alt: House with stone lower walls and timber-clad upper floor
Covered veranda lounge opening onto the garden
Dining table with a green upholstered bench
Pair of garden chairs on a paved terrace at sunset

title: Casa Legno
summary: A compact timber-clad house at the edge of the Valdorsa woods, with a sunny bay-window kitchen and a garden studio.
description:
Casa Legno is a compact two-storey house clad in charred and natural timber, set at the end of a lane where the valley meets the woods. The kitchen sits in a deep bay window overlooking the garden.

There are three bedrooms and two bathrooms, plus a separate garden studio currently used as a pottery workshop.

A quiet, practical home within ten minutes' drive of Valdorsa's schools and station.

images.alt: Timber-clad modern house among trees
Kitchen sink in a bright bay window
Bedroom with dark wood bed and morning sun on the floor

title: Casa Curva

coverImage.alt: White house with a curved upper storey and glass balustrades

summary: A white house with a curved upper storey near the Capo Lume lighthouse, built around a double-height gallery living room.
description:
Casa Curva's rounded upper storey turns the corner of its plot towards the lighthouse, giving the principal bedroom a 180-degree view of the cape. Below, a double-height gallery living room is lit from a clerestory and opens onto a sheltered garden.

The house has four bedrooms, each with a bathroom, plus a study and a utility room.

Completed in 2022, it is built to near-passive standards with triple glazing and mechanical ventilation.

images.alt: White house with a curved upper storey and glass balustrades
Double-height living room with a gallery
Calm sea and distant headland in early morning light

title: Via dei Limoni, Apartment 2

coverImage.alt: Narrow old-town street with balconies and plants

summary: A renovated first-floor apartment in a 1920s townhouse in the old village, with tall shuttered windows and a tiled kitchen.
description:
This first-floor apartment sits in a 1928 townhouse on Via dei Limoni, one of the stepped lanes of Castel Ombra's old village. It was renovated in 2019, keeping the original ceiling heights, shutters and terracotta floors.

The kitchen has white tiles, a marble worktop and a window over the lane; two bedrooms and a bathroom sit at the quieter rear of the building.

The village square, bakery and weekly market are two minutes' walk away.

images.alt: Narrow old-town street with balconies and plants
White-tiled kitchen worktop with a bowl of lemons
Simple white living room with a grey sofa

title: Attico Faro
summary: A top-floor penthouse with angled glazing that frames the lighthouse, a corner principal suite and a rooftop terrace.
description:
Attico Faro crowns a small building of six apartments in the Faro quarter. Its facade of angled glass panels turns each window slightly towards the lighthouse and the open sea.

The living room has a corner sofa arranged around the view; the principal bedroom takes the opposite corner with windows on two sides. A private stair leads to a rooftop terrace with an outdoor shower.

Two parking spaces and a storage room are included.

images.alt: Facade of angled glass panels
Living room with a tufted grey sofa
Corner bedroom with windows on two sides
